data.name: Flossy
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word ‘flosian’, meaning ‘to float’ or ‘to drift’, Flossy is a charming name that exudes softness and delicacy. It is a name that can be given to a baby girl with a gentle and graceful spirit, and who is likely to be as lovely and fragile as a flower.
